messages:
alex: Hey team — trying to spin up a new GPU nodepool in asia-central1 for low-latency infer. Hit quota + egress issues. Anyone familiar with this region?
maya: I started the quota request yesterday but cloud replied we only have 8 A10G GPUs available in that zone. need to pick instance types.
sam: Are we planning on preemptible instances or reserved? cost vs stability tradeoff.
jordan: For inference burst, preemptible (spot) with a small reserved baseline is fine. But note asia-central1 has very limited external NAT IPs, egress SNAT exhaustion was a problem on our last rollout.
alex: Ugh. SNAT exhaustion — that explains some of the pod evictions I saw. How many NAT IPs do we get by default?
maya: Default 2 for the NAT gateway in that project. The cluster needs ~10 concurrent node egress flows during image pulls at scale.
sam: Workarounds: (1) add a NAT pool / increase floating IPs, (2) use Cloud NAT with per-instance IP, or (3) avoid large parallel pulls by pre-pulling images via DaemonSet on new nodes.
jordan: Also consider using private GCR/registry mirror in the region to reduce egress. We did that in eu-west1 and it cut pulls by 70%.
alex: Good call. For the GPU SKU — provider only allowed A10G and T4. A10G better perf but more quota-limited. Any benchmarks?
maya: T4 is cheaper with lower memory. For our 4k token models A10G gives ~20% latency win. For most production configs T4 is OK if we batch correctly.
sam: Suggestion: create heterogenous nodepool: small base of A10G reserved (min 2, max 6) and a larger T4 burst pool (min 0, max 20 preemptible). Use nodeSelector + taints to route heavy models to A10G.
jordan: Adjust cluster-autoscaler config: scale-up-delay 0s, expander: least-waste, and set max-node-provision-time to 10m. Also ensure PodPriority for canaries.
alex: Sounds good. Two blockers: (A) quota request for more A10G (B) NAT IP shortage. Who can file tickets?
maya: I have a support ticket draft for quota with cloud — will push now and cc infra.
sam: I'll open an infra ticket to provision a NAT pool and request extra egress IPs.
jordan: I'll add a CLI snippet for the nodepool plan: ```gcloud container node-pools create gpu-asia-central --cluster=redwood-asia --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --accelerator type=nvidia-a10g,count=1 --num-nodes=2 --min-nodes=2 --max-nodes=6 --node-taints=inference=gpu:NoSchedule --enable-autoscaling```
alex: Perfect. Can we also add a warm pool of CPU-only nodes to soak images and warm caches so when GPUs spin up they don't all pull images at once?
maya: Yes — add a small nodepool `warm-images` with pre-pull DaemonSet. I'll add the YAML.
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-5423: "Request additional NAT IPs for asia-central1" assigned to sam.
sam: INFRA-5423 created. ETA for provisioning depends on cloud approval, but might be 48-72h.
alex: OK — immediate plan: (1) maya files quota for A10G (2) sam files NAT ticket and starts warm pool (3) jordan posts nodepool create PR with autoscaler changes. We'll reconvene after cloud replies.
maya: cc @support-team-org on quota. sending now :rocket:
alex: Thanks — leaning on preemptible burst + reserved A10G baseline. Will update the rollout doc when we have quotas.
sam: FYI cost estimate if we do 2 reserved A10G + up to 20 T4 spot: ~ $12k/month baseline, bursts extra.
jordan: I'll add autoscaler budgets to the console dashboard and alert on SNAT exhaustion metrics.
alex: Great. If cloud rejects extra A10G, fallback plan: migrate heavier models to US-west with replication. Not ideal but possible.
maya: noted. updating the runbook now.
